ias.disclaimer.title: In-Gaem Account Switchur: Securitee Disclamer
ias.disclaimer.text: In ur gaem fowldur a sub-fowldur named '_IAS_ACCOUNTS_DO_NOT_SEND_TO_ANYONE' haz bin creatd. DO NOT SEND DIS SUB-FOWLDUR 2 ANYONE, EVEN IF THEY SAY THEY R DE DEVELOPURZ OF DIS MOD. If u did send dis fowldur 2 anyone, follow teh stepz describd in teh 'READ_ME_IMPORTANT.txt' file in dat sub-fowldur or teh guidelinez on teh mod's page. U can also look at teh mod's page 2 undurstand wut Crypt iz, why it iz needed n how 2 maek shur ur account/token iz saef.

ias.disabled.text: Dis vershun of teh mod haz bin disabld due 2 vulnurabilitee or odr critikal problumz. See teh mod's page 4 moar info. U wont be able 2 use teh currunt vershun of teh mod.

ias.error: An unexpectd errur haz occurrd. See teh log filez and/or gaem console 4 teknikal detailz. While we tried 2 remove any sensetiv data, u shud *NOT* publish ur logz.
ias.error.connect: Unable 2 connect 2 Microsoft authuntikashun servurz. Probly ur internet isnt workin or servurz r blockd by ur firewall, ur ISP, and/or ur 'hosts' file. ias.error.noXbox: Ur Microsoft account duznt have an Xbox account linkd. Most likely dis account duznt own a copy of teh gaem. Try addin dis account again or into teh official launcher. ias.error.noProfile: Ur Xbox account duznt have a Minecraft profile. Most likely dis account duznt own a copy of teh gaem or u did not set up teh profile 4 teh Xbox Game Pass. Try addin dis account again or into teh official launcher 2 set up teh profile. See teh log filez and/or gaem console 4 teknikal detailz. While we tried 2 remove any sensetiv data, u shud *NOT* publish ur logz.
ias.error.world: U tried 2 change ur account while connectd 2 a wurld or servur. Quit 2 teh main menu n try again. See teh log filez and/or gaem console 4 teknikal detailz. While we tried 2 remove any sensetiv data, u shud *NOT* publish ur logz.
ias.error.note: Note: A screenshot of dis errur screen plus sayin "plz help i cant login" iz NOT enough 4 teh mod developurz 2 help u wif any problumz.
